{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows no positive signal (all 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows strong downward momentum and true outcome is below model.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral (0.00) and true outcome has recently dipped below 60.00.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if model is above 65.00 for 3+ consecutive days with no sentiment shift, reduce forecast by 2-5%.",
    "If model spikes above 70.00 after a 60-day downtrend, cap forecast at 68.00 to avoid overshoot.",
    "When sentiment history includes a 0.50, slightly increase forecast bias toward historical mean (last 15-day average) to reflect market sentiment.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, if true outcome is consistently 5-10% below model, apply a 3-5% downward bias correction for next period.",
    "If true outcome shows a sharp upward move after a 30-day low, adjust forecast to reflect 10-15% lagged momentum, not immediate reversal."
  ]
}
